nodes.label: FloCafe (upstream project)
nodes.rationale: 4.0.0 is the first release of the fork; entries at 3.3.0 and below are upstream FloCafe history, kept for context because they describe inherited code.

nodes.label: Floor map with rooms (migration v75)
Floor map keeps its size in edit mode
nodes.rationale: The edit band took about 145 px of height and the map scale fell from 0.45 to 0.35; Floor plans / Add room / Add Table now replace the day chip and Bookings in the page bar, which edit mode does not need.

nodes.label: Floor map scale fits width and height (30% floor)
nodes.rationale: The map used to scale on width only with a 70% floor, so a large room ran 444 px too wide on the till's ~816x481 frame; only a frame too small to be legible (under 30%) falls back to scrolling.

nodes.label: New application icon in two variants (simplified mark and full illustration)
nodes.rationale: The full illustration collapses into a smudge at 16-24 px, so a simplified mark is used up to 48 px.

nodes.label: Products tab category filter
nodes.rationale: A drop-down rather than one button per category: on the 1024x768 till the buttons wrapped over four rows and pushed the table below the fold. Outlined in the brand colour while filtering so a short list does not pass for the whole menu; Add Product starts in the filtered category.

nodes.label: Rename Flo Cafe to BuonApp (it.buonapp.pos, buonapp.local)
Table tiles show seats and the full name
nodes.rationale: With the whole room fitted to the till most tiles are small; seats shown as people icon plus number like the handheld, name sized by its own length down to 10 px, to-send badge replaced by an outline where it does not fit.

Chromium keeps zoom per origin, so all localhost windows follow while the KDS window on the network address stays at 100%.

nodes.label: Counted fixed menu (menu line with quantity N)
nodes.rationale: The floor writes how many menus, then how many of each dish, never who eats what; the menus stepper has no starting number because mixed menu/card tables are common and starting from covers would charge menus nobody took.

nodes.label: Cover charge (migrations v88-v90)
nodes.rationale: Printed line spells out Cover N x price only when the multiplication gives the amount beside it.

nodes.label: New order starts from the table's covers
Fixed menu (migration v92)
nodes.rationale: Choosing a menu writes real rows, one per dish, because the kitchen ticket sections dishes by product category and a package has none.

nodes.label: Folding identical dishes (ticket, table, bill)
nodes.rationale: Rows stay apart in the order (each has round, run, kitchen state, price); folding happens only where they are read. Rows with different notes, add-ons, variants or runs are never folded.

Services/routes split with no import cycle

nodes.label: Release 6.4.0 - kitchen ticket without lines inside a run
Nothing drawn between dishes inside a service run
nodes.rationale: The dashed rule between dishes and the == SECONDI == rule a multi-category station got were both read at the pass as the start of the next run, and a category's name means nothing to a cook; dishes of one category still sit together in first-appearance order, and the only line inside the list of dishes is the run's.

nodes.label: Service-run rule spans the full 48 columns
nodes.rationale: The ## 2ª USCITA ## rule was cut at 24 characters as if it printed in double width, while it prints in double height only, so it stopped halfway across the paper.

nodes.label: Covers printed under the table, ticket number on the condensed line
nodes.rationale: The floor calls a table by its number and its party size together, so 6 COPERTI takes the double-height line under the table that COMANDA N. 1 had, and the ticket number moves to the condensed line (20:35 - Comanda n. 1 - Cucina); a takeaway or a table with no covers set has no covers line.

nodes.label: Table's note printed before the dishes
nodes.rationale: Printed under the last dish, a note on the order was found last by a cook reading from the top; right under the header, on every station's ticket, an allergy at the table is read before anything is cooked.

nodes.label: One quantity-column width per kitchen ticket
nodes.rationale: Sized dish by dish, a two-digit quantity such as 10 moved its name, add-ons and note one column right of every other dish.

nodes.label: Ticket footer in the singular (1 riga - 1 pezzo)
Default printer named in the ticket's language (Cucina)
nodes.rationale: Dishes no station claims printed under Kitchen on an Italian ticket; only the unnamed default printer is localized, so a station the owner actually called Kitchen keeps its name.
